method: Read all 151 correction, collection, invalidation, mutation, production-maturity and historical-boundary propositions, all 24 complete context profiles and 14 exact caption/classification sets. Nine historical metadata/commit contexts have empty governed sets; quoted report content is inspected only as controlling source classification, with no referenced proof artifact opened. Every full original payload and all 842 ordered bindings are verified against immutable evidence and pinned source bytes. The existential normal clarification cycle is distinguished from A structured fallback. Twelve exact two-space representation qualifications are preserved at index7025. Archived inputs are verified in memory against durable regular-member custody; no implementation, tests or proof results were consulted.

decisions.PRESERVED_CORRECTION: Each exact Stage16 explanation, five outcome classes, Stage14 responsible-layer determination, application-owned mechanics and seven causal correction cases remain. An execution-only defect cannot justify changing a correct instruction, and human authority cannot be supplied by agent reinterpretation. A/F1/F2 preserve input lifecycle, owning stages and executor boundaries; this retention does not certify a particular current correction as valid.
decisions.PRESERVED_COLLECTION: The exclusive five-policy choice, current-set supersession with retained history/downstream invalidation, append-only correction, distinct content/record hashes, monotonic event ordering and untrusted browser timestamp limitation remain. E reinforces the inner-object/enclosing-record distinction. No new locator or input echo authorizes history deletion, canonical identity substitution or external time claims.
decisions.PRESERVED_INVALIDATION: Every exact later-stage accepted change, record, prompt, proposal, confirmation, convergence, release, identity batch, evidence batch and delivery authorization is conservatively invalidated when StageN changes. The demonstrably-unusable exception for replacing conservative invalidation remains. New semantic triggers use this rule; retention does not assert the old concrete dependency closure is complete.
decisions.EXACT_CAPTION_OR_HISTORICAL_CLASSIFICATI: Every normative caption preserves its exact actor/modality, list boundary and individual governed ranges/IDs; standalone adjacent clauses are not absorbed. The nine supplied metadata/commit contexts have empty governed sets and remain expressly historical, unverified and nonaccepting. Quoted historical report content is read only as source classification context, not as runtime or proof evidence.
decisions.PRESERVED_MUTATION_BOUNDARIES: The exact generic mutation types, intentional-failure requirement for meaningful assertions, isolated disposable-state alternatives and separate no-canonical-user/no-unauthorized-target mutation proofs remain. F1 expressly preserves isolation/authorization/restoration and F2 cannot replace objective evidence with echoes. Actual new gate, native-support and intake completeness duties are separately changed; retaining a mutation category proves no executed detection.
decisions.PRESERVED_MATURITY_SPECIFIC_BOUNDARIES: The existential rejected-response and upstream-correction examples, finished-product artifacts, externally exported backup, release-byte verification and separately recorded authorized export/share attempt remain exact evidence-kind/custody/order requirements. Input echoes do not become external custody, physical transfer or released-byte verification. Actual current acceptance/restore/authorization remain separate duties.
decisions.PRESERVED_REAL_PROJECT_EXPOSURE: Each exact suggested real-project question, resupply, context, evidence, independence, executability, schema, gate, live-path and visual failure category remains, as does permanent regression coverage for every discovered failure. A–F2 adds concrete cases without deleting categories, granting mutation authority or implying a real project was executed.
decisions.PRESERVED_INSPECT_PRESERVE_BOUNDARY: The exact starting-commit discovery and individually named inspection duties remain source requirements. Existing verified custody, raw-first ingestion, artifact store and independent verification safeguards remain; F2 expressly does not establish possession or hidden independence. The conditional genuinely-correct predicates for current routing, context, panel and complete lifecycle are separately changed. No existing implementation is inspected or certified here.
decisions.PRESERVED_HISTORICAL_NONACCEPTANCE: The supplied report and metadata remain unverified historical material, unable to satisfy every individually named current profile, transport, human, challenge, native, due, independence, evidence, delivery, physical-device, visual or live-path requirement. Preserve original values and indentation qualifications without normalization. No referenced report or commit was opened; old values establish no current acceptance.
decisions.CURRENT_NEW_GATE_MUTATION_PROOF: The actual current gate universe includes applicable A–F2 request/answer, proof, accounting, native, variance, due/route and input-basis contracts. Each requires its own deliberately invalid state, actual detection, repair and progression under the original isolated-state/no-unauthorized-mutation limits. Old generic assertions cannot establish detection of the amended invalid states; source-only inherited edges require their own attributed linkage.
decisions.CURRENT_UNSUPPORTED_NATIVE_MUTATION: The supported native operation boundary now consumes D exact closed primitives, argument/value/parser/selector/result semantics and current semantic identities, with applicable F2 route input custody. Preserve native authority and no silent fallback. Selected-node XML meaning requires explicit attributed linkage where this actual definition depends on it.
decisions.CURRENT_INTAKE_MUTATIONS: Current incomplete Stage01 raw/semantic accounting, uninspected input and Stage04 obligation mutations consume C/C1 distinct physical/structural occurrences, retained raw parents/authorized verified children and exact blocked/unknown resource outcomes. A current confirmed human context applies where consumed. Coarse file counts, fabricated zeros or repeated resupply cannot substitute for exact accounting.
decisions.CURRENT_FUNCTIONAL_AND_PRODUCTION_COMPLE: Actual complete synthetic/deployed/real-project acceptance, current restore, physical-iPhone acceptance, terminal checkpoint/authorization and full maturity proof consume applicable A–F2 semantics. Preserve actual exported bytes, exact current device/commit/challenge identity, physical observation and separate transfer evidence. Prior reports or matching identity tuples do not establish amended behavior; this is a source obligation, not acceptance evidence.
decisions.CURRENT_REAL_CLARIFICATION: Where a real clarification uses the structured fallback, A supplies closed request and typed-answer rules. The source does not require all conversational clarification to use that fallback; the separately corrected existential cycle obligation retains its original meaning.
decisions.CURRENT_REAL_NATIVE_ROUTE: A real native project under current language/registry identities consumes D closed semantics, B accepted reviewed availability, E applicable current variance context and F2 actual native input custody. Preserve native executor and no fallback; this establishes neither real execution nor its success. Typed XML interpretation must be explicitly linked where effective.
decisions.CURRENT_REAL_EXTERNAL_ROUTE: The real external file-first route consumes current A/B/D/E response/proof/test rules and F1 current compatible binding/history/phase/target where applicable, with F2 attributable exact manifest/member echoes as minimum only. Stronger review, independence, observation, safety and evidence requirements remain; no echo is actual execution or physical transfer proof.
decisions.CURRENT_CORRECT_EXECUTION_PLAN: The conditional genuinely-correct preservation predicate for execution planning, native support rejection and mandatory capability now depends on B reviewed availability, D closed native semantics, F1 conditional due/binding and F2 route input basis. Mere inspection duties remain unchanged. No implementation inspection or acceptance is inferred from the source label.
decisions.CURRENT_CORRECT_CONTEXT_ISOLATION: A genuinely correct run-contamination mechanism must accommodate F1 selected fixture/history/target inputs while preserving prior-run/verifier/future-phase exclusion and exact current scope. No unknown specialized binding is silently treated as empty safe context; sole ownership and fresh-context discipline remain.
decisions.CURRENT_CORRECT_NEXT_ACTION_AND_LIFECYCL: A genuinely correct current next-action panel or complete thirty-stage lifecycle must handle applicable A request/answer, B proof, C/C1 intake, D native, E variance and F1/F2 due/route/input conditions. Original ownership, ordered stages and ten executions remain. Old behavior names or successful historical results do not establish amended correctness.
decisions.CORRECTION_6974: Base5515 requires at least one real Stage01 clarification cycle with application confirmation of any newly supplied human-origin answer. Base1523–1533 makes conversation normal and humanInputRequests only the final structured fallback; base1557 expressly permits external conversational answers confirmed or corrected through humanAuthorityCandidates without retyping. A successor1639–1650 closes fallback requests and SAVE_HUMAN_INPUT answers only; it does not require every real clarification cycle to instantiate a fallback. Retain the existential cycle/confirmation obligation and exact original occurrence set; actual fallback request/answer duties remain separately amended.

qualifier: The separately accepted technical-reference interpretation resolves policy meaning in its exact attributed scope. These historical reference qualifiers are preserved pending explicit per-entry effective-dependency and typed-governor linkage review; they are not a claim that the normative input remains missing or an automatic scope-wide identity change.
